WHAT I COULD NOT DO, AND WHY - The "cart-dr-east absent on every gateway" check still reads "no" as the 14:00 UTC window closed. 128 leased snapshots (longest lease 8h) pin the old set until their leases expire; the mesh drops the candidate only when the last lease drains, ~20:50 UTC. - The only mechanism that would have finished before 14:00 was destroying the cartDrEast RDS instance in the recovery-east stack, whose deletion tombstone drops it from every set immediately.
